_**Agent (Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium) 2026-07-09 23:41:46Z)**_

Both plugins now import cleanly with `✔ mcpServers : 1 processed`. Here's what was wrong and what was fixed:

## Root Cause & Fix

**Problem:** `agy` expects `mcpServers` in `gemini-extension.json` to be a **JSON object/map** (keyed by server name), but both plugins used a **JSON array** with an `id` field:

```diff
- "mcpServers": [
-   {
-     "id": "ability-dna",
-     "command": "python3", ...
-   }
- ]
+ "mcpServers": {
+   "ability-dna": {
+     "command": "python3", ...
+   }
+ }
```

**Files fixed (4 total):**
- [`~/.gemini/extensions/ability-dna/gemini-extension.json`](file:///Users/steven/.gemini/extensions/ability-dna/gemini-extension.json)
- [`~/.gemini/extensions/upwork-intelligence/gemini-extension.json`](file:///Users/steven/.gemini/extensions/upwork-intelligence/gemini-extension.json)
- [`~/my-supremepowers/extensions/ability-dna/gemini-extension.json`](file:///Users/steven/my-supremepowers/extensions/ability-dna/gemini-extension.json) *(canonical)*
- [`~/my-supremepowers/extensions/upwork-intelligence/gemini-extension.json`](file:///Users/steven/my-supremepowers/extensions/upwork-intelligence/gemini-extension.json) *(canonical)*

> [!TIP]
> Note that the `commands` fields in these two plugins were **not imported** (`- commands : skipped (not found)`) — if you want those slash commands available in `agy`, the commands need to be in a `commands/` directory structure that `agy` can discover, not just inline in `gemini-extension.json`.
